verdict.rationale: The deprecations and models-compare pages show OpenAI tracks specific dated model versions and recommends replacements (e.g. gpt-4-32k → gpt-4o), implying some notion of versioned vs. aliased models, but no evidence explicitly documents an alias-to-version mapping policy (e.g. what 'gpt-4o' or 'GPT-5.6 Terra' resolves to, or how/when aliases update). missing for 10: explicit documentation of alias-to-snapshot mapping, guarantees about alias update cadence, and confirmation that dated/pinned model IDs remain callable indefinitely.
